body:
Corrected missing daily counter footers in In motion and Events by sharing the bounded pin snapshot projection. Active values and observed card versions arrive together, without history or per-card source reads. Counter saves remain explicit and conditional.

The combined release-profile full gate passes 469 tests; affected Chromium/WebKit suites verify footers, cancelled pointer edits, keyboard saves, archived-counter omission, narrow layouts and reload persistence. The initial default compilation exhausted disk space; the equivalent gate used release Rust Clippy/tests without reducing checks or fixture bounds.

The rebuilt manual application preserves all 79 prior versions, three pins, preferences, certificate, instance/epoch and normalized full CLI context. Trusted original HTTPS verifies all 32 embedded assets. Evidence: progress/2026-10-01-focus-section-counters.md. No scope, focus or card acceptance changed.

metadata.summary: Daily counter footers verified in all Focus card sections
